title: Domain rigid-offset Timoshenko frame element

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root FrameElement2DTimoshenkoRigidOffsets export is re-exported from the migrated implementation

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript rigid-offset Timoshenko modules, including root export identity, inheritance isolation, exact matrices and vectors, exact JSON serialization, Unicode metadata, defaults, and constructor and unsupported-input errors.

tolerances.numericParity: exact equality for matrices, vectors and lengths
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality
tolerances.errors: exact error name and message equality

parityDifferences: The strict TypeScript declarations describe the existing JavaScript rigid-offset Timoshenko element contract without adding runtime behavior.
Element loads with non-zero rigid offsets remain unsupported exactly as in the pinned JavaScript source.
engineeringFunctionality: Solver-neutral 2D Timoshenko frame stiffness and displacement transformation with rigid end offsets, explicit or derived deformable reference nodes, exact serialization, and the source-defined unsupported element-load behavior.
